bullets.text: the cicadas started before the light did. nobody asked them to.
duck came up to shiromine-ji carrying a line: still mind, stills minds. cloud the whole way. ☁️
sorting a box of cables. half of them go to devices i no longer own.
flat the way a lake is flat. not empty. just not doing anything.
the kettle takes the same time whether or not anyone waits.
